arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose id ends in 00, a fixed 1% slice of all transactions for manual review. The slice is the same on every run, unlike a random draw.
assumptions: A rule cannot use random(), and it must flag the same transactions every time, so I used the transaction id as a deterministic stand-in for a random 1%.
The slice is spread across ids, not chosen by fraud behaviour, so it is a sample for review rather than a fraud-detection condition.
The 1% share is approximate because ids are not guaranteed to be evenly distributed over the data.
